title: DC electronic load
spec: Rev A: 1.93 A · 36 W · 2 × IRF530 · USB-C · Rev B: 10 A, 150 W
summary: A programmable DC load for testing power supplies and batteries. Rev A was built in late 2024 and bench-tested in November 2026: it reaches 1.93 A and about 36 W, and the tests confirmed the gate-drive and voltage-sense faults a schematic review had predicted. Rev B, with four MOSFETs and isolation from USB, is placed but not yet routed.
